crossRefs.note: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.
They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.
Then Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, I will rain bread from the sky for you, and the people shall go out and gather a…
When the dew that lay had gone, behold, on the surface of the wilderness was a small round thing, small as the frost on…
He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know…
and gave them bread from the sky for their hunger, and brought water out of the rock for them for their thirst, and…
You gave also your good Spirit to instruct them, and didn’t withhold your manna from their mouth, and gave them water…
Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’ ”
and all ate the same spiritual food;

translations.web: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.
translations.bsb: He rained down manna for them to eat; He gave them grain from heaven.
translations.kjv: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.
translations.asv: And he rained down manna upon them to eat, And gave them food from heaven.
